title: Hyronsecurity
description: A Good And Fast Security Plugin
body:
# HyronSecurity

**Compatibility: Spigot/Paper/Purpur**

**Creator And Owner: Mr_Stable**

**Manager: Samiop12**

**WARN** : Use ProtocolLIB

## Key Features
- 
-      Anti Tab Complete Exploit:
-      Blockes When A Player Trys To Send So Much Tab Complete Request to crash the server.
-      
-      Anti Book Exploit:
-      Blocks Books With Bad NBT!.
-      
-      Admin Whitelist:
-      Exempts specific players (e.g., admins) from Security checks
-      
-      Automatic kick Option:
-      Optionally kicks players caught Crashing,
 
### Available Commands & Permissions

-   hyronsecurity.admin:
-     description: Full Admin CONTROL.
-   hyronsecurity.alert:
-     description: Sees The Alerts Of Crashes
-   hyronsecurity.reload:
-     description: Allows reloading the plugin configuration.
